text:
Great! I've found your account, Mei. I can see you have a few orders on file: #W7553978, #W3239882, and #W2598324.

You mentioned you're upset about some items you received. Could you please tell me which order number you're referring to, and what specifically you're unhappy about? This will help me better assist you with your concerns.
zh:
太好了！我找到了你的账户，梅。我看到你有一些订单记录：#W7553978、#W3239882和#W2598324。

你提到你对收到的某些商品不高兴。你能告诉我你指的是哪个订单号，具体是什么让你不满意吗？这将帮助我更好地协助你处理相关事宜。
